critic.fix_suggestion: Replace the single solid grey block on the fuselage side with an array of 12-15 small, individual rectangular planes. Each plane should have a width of 0.4 units and a height of 0.8 units, spaced 0.1 units apart along the horizontal axis of the cabin section to create a continuous window line.

discrepancies.reference: A continuous horizontal line of small, individual rectangular windows
discrepancies.direction_of_fix: replace with a repeated array of small cubes/planes

discrepancies.direction_of_fix: subdivide into 4-6 individual flat planes with slight angles
